held-in.focus: additionalProperties:false must also hold for nested object schemas
enum and union constraints remain explicit and strict
optional versus nullable arguments are represented correctly
opaque cursor pagination and continuation metadata
resource template discovery and parameterized reads
prompt discovery, required arguments, and rendered messages
binary/blob response metadata without corrupting protocol output
validation, not-found, and internal failures map to distinct protocol errors

bounded operation timeout and clear timeout errors
overlapping tool calls do not leak transient state
create/update/get tools share consistent persistent state
logs stay on stderr and stdout remains protocol-only
defaults are documented and applied without weakening validation
batch tools return deterministic per-item success and failure records

held-out.focus: recursive structured input with bounded validation
strict prompt argument schemas and missing/extra input rejection
monotonic progress events without polluting final responses
fragmented and multiple messages preserve framing
request retry does not duplicate side effects
invalid or stale cursors return stable recoverable errors
